description: Create a data model in the workspace. Field types include select/multiselect (provide `options`), relation (link to another model via `relationTo` = the target model's slug + `relationType`), and object/list (nested `fields`/`itemFields`). Optional model-level config: slug, description, icon, color, displayField, defaultSort, statusField, `product` (commerce capability: enabled, priceField, skuField, inventoryField, variantAxes), `auth` (accounts: enabled, identityField, companyField/companyRoleField for a B2B company link), `uniqueFields` (field keys whose value must be unique - lets import_records update by that key) and `deliveryAccess` - a model is "none" (admin only) by default, so pass "public" when the user's app must read it through the delivery API. Only call AFTER the user has explicitly agreed to a structure you proposed (e.g. replied yes / clicked 'Yes, create'). Never create without that explicit go-ahead.

acceptedTypes.description: For a 'media' field: allowed media kinds (empty = all).

fields.description: For an 'object' field: nested field definitions.

hidden.description: Hide the field from admin forms (still stored on records).

itemFields.description: For a 'list' of objects: nested field definitions.

itemType.description: For a 'list' field: the type of each item.

localized.description: Store this field's value per language: { en: '...', pl: '...' }. Only 'text', 'textarea', 'richText' and 'markdown' may be translatable - a translatable price or sku would corrupt the catalog and is rejected.

multiple.description: For a 'media' field: true = gallery, false = single.

options.description: Choices for a 'select' or 'multiselect' field. Required (non-empty) for those types.

relationTo.description: For a 'relation' field: the slug of the model to link to (e.g. 'category', from list_models). Required for relation fields.

relationType.description: For a 'relation' field: cardinality. 'hasOne' = one linked record, 'hasMany' = many. If omitted, treated as 'hasOne'.

auth.description: Accounts config PATCH: omitted keys keep their stored values, null clears a company key. enabled turns the model into an accounts (customer) model.

companyField.description: Relation field (hasOne, to another model) naming the customer's company; null unlinks the company and clears companyRoleField.

companyRoleField.description: Select field holding the customer's role in the company; needs companyField.

identityField.description: Email or text field that identifies the account (default 'email')

deliveryAccess.description: Who can read this model through the delivery API: "public" (any app with the workspace endpoint - required for a content API), "members" (signed-in site members only), "none" (admin only, the default).

displayField.description: Field key used as the record's display label in UI

product.description: Product capability config PATCH: omitted keys keep their stored values (defaults on first enable: skuField 'sku', priceField 'price', inventoryField 'inventory', variantAxes [], name/currency/image/taxRate overrides null). The cart reads every product field through these roles - there is no per-cart field mapping. E.g. {variantAxes: []} clears the axes without touching anything else.

currencyField.description: Field key holding the ISO 4217 currency of a record. null clears the override; unset it resolves to 'currency', and a record without one sells in the cart's defaultCurrency.

imageField.description: Field key holding the product image the cart snapshots. null clears the override; unset it resolves to 'image'.

inventoryField.description: Field key holding the stock count (default 'inventory')

nameField.description: Field key holding the product name the cart shows. null clears the override; unset it resolves to the model's displayField, then 'name'.

priceField.description: Field key holding the unit price in minor units (default 'price')

taxRateField.description: Field key holding the id of the tax rate (from the cart config) that applies to a record. null clears the override; unset it resolves to 'taxRate'.

variantAxes.description: Field keys used as variant axes (e.g. ['size','color']). Every axis must be an existing select field on the model. Pass [] to clear all axes.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (lowercase). Derived from name when omitted.

statusField.description: Enable record lifecycle states with allowed transitions

transitions.description: Allowed transitions: from one state to a set of states

uniqueFields.description: Keys of top-level text, email, url, phone or number fields whose value no two records may share (not translatable fields, not the product price/stock fields). Replaces the whole list; [] removes every constraint. Refused while existing records already share a value - the error lists them.

name: create_model
